title: CppCon 2018: Nicolai Josuttis “The Nightmare of Initialization in C++”
summary: Nicolai Josuttis's CppCon 2018 talk walks through the many forms of initialization in C++, including uniform initialization, and how their rules and effects differ. He argues the situation is confusing enough that nobody can say what to teach beginners.
why: Used mostly as a citation of C++'s historical baggage and complexity when HN criticizes or jokes about the language.
